scope: Bounded alternative in the frozen ticket. The proof concerns the classes and sharp bounds listed here, with an unrestricted rival. The overall unrestricted theorem is open on ticket E.
conclusion: Pair distances through five identify all junctions, states and next groups against unrestricted rivals for the proved high-junction source classes. This horizon is sharp, including for finite three-dimensional predecessor arrangements that allow arbitrary adjacent two-output three-parent sites. Triple invariance for two unrestricted mixed presentations remains open.
reader_input: The complete current pair table, clipped at the stated threshold if desired, plus an unordered mark. No site or history flags.
primary_class: All-size one-sided inverse for high ordinary junctions
sufficient_source_classes: Only one ternary site, all four-place sites born unary, and every bond of size at most six surrounds at most two sites.
Every site makes three new distinctions, except at most five three-parent sites taking the two-output option anywhere, or arbitrarily many such sites with pairwise ordinary distance at least three.

Any finite three-dimensional coordinate downset, with any subset of its three-parent sites omitting one unused positive direction each. No spacing condition, and no such structure is required of a rival.
One two-output binary site whose two parents began unary on the same seed or high site, all other additions having three outputs.
separate_terminal_theorem: An all-two-output unary/binary prefix followed by one high last join has every marked triple forced even under unrestricted competitors. For two arbitrary one-join extensions of the same known prefix, with old incidence and fresh bits matched, a single fresh row through K=h+3 is sufficient and sharp.
unrestricted_obligation: Exclude or realize a full marked-table isometry with opposite legal triple verdicts when neither marked part satisfies a one-sided theorem. A new equation alone or an isometry of a clipped table alone is insufficient.
validation_class: V1 same-task independent proof reviews, direct cut and parity replays. Separate external referee pending for predecessor results as reported by owner.
assumptions: A97 remains under challenge. No new assumption or long-term goal.
